name: Sensei
source:
Dreaming of becoming a teacher or a doctor after graduation, currently at an internship at a hospital after receiving an offer.

Kind-hearted, gentle to others, not too serious, but rather funny.
Takes care of Yan Ye as well as 5 other patients of similar age.
